title: Ziv Meets Sumcheck: Zero-Knowledge Proofs of Floating-Point LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.29188v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Zero-knowledge proofs can show that a neural network produced a given output without revealing the network, but current systems for language models prove integer approximations of the model rather than the floating-point arithmetic that is actually deployed. Proving floating-point matrix multiplication has been regarded as hard, because rounding after every addition makes the result depend on the order of the additions. We avoid this obstacle by proving the correctly rounded product, in which every dot product is computed exactly and rounded once. This result is independent of the hardware and at least as accurate as standard kernels. translated_title: Ziv 遇见 Sumcheck：浮点数大语言模型推理的零知识证明
translated_abstract: 零知识证明可以在不泄露神经网络本身的情况下证明某个神经网络产生了给定的输出，但当前针对语言模型的系统证明的是模型的整数近似，而非实际部署中所使用的浮点运算。证明浮点矩阵乘法一直被视为难题，因为每次加法后的舍入会使结果依赖于加法的执行顺序。我们通过证明“正确舍入的乘积”来规避这一障碍：其中每个点积都被精确计算并只进行一次舍入。该结果与硬件无关，且精度至少不低于标准内核。我们针对这一关系给出了一个交互式证明，其成本接近整数矩阵乘法的成本，所承诺的值数量比逐操作浮点电路所需的约束数量少约一千倍；我们将其扩展到 Transformer 的每一层，并针对协……的隐私构造（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于 sumcheck 协议的交互式证明方法，通过证明“正确舍入”的浮点矩阵乘积（即精确计算点积后仅舍入一次），实现了与硬件无关、精度不低于标准内核，且成本接近整数矩阵乘法的浮点数大语言模型推理零知识证明。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces an interactive proof based on the sumcheck protocol for correctly rounded floating-point matrix multiplication—computing each dot product exactly with a single rounding—enabling hardware-independent, cost-efficient zero-knowledge proofs of floating-point LLM inference.
